candidate_statement: The blind primitive substrate canonically determines the unlabeled S3-orbit signature lambda(n)=sort(n) and the induced token partition by component type, but it does not canonically select a unique nontrivial scalar readout or semantic magnitude/scale role. Multiple inequivalent intrinsic scalar readouts survive (including total token cardinality, support cardinality, largest type-block size, cross-type unordered-pair cardinality, and same-type unordered-pair cardinality). A unique scalar requires extra datum selecting an underlying finite construction and/or valuation law; additivity plus S3 symmetry plus unit normalization would conditionally select total token cardinality, but those requirements are not primitive.
semantic_layer: derived structural quotient plus nonunique numerical readout family; no Foundation promotion
structural_motivation_without_active_rou: Quotient presentation-specific token names and component labels by the exact automorphism group of the blind substrate. The resulting complete invariant is the sorted multiplicity triple. Derived finite objects admit several inequivalent cardinality valuations, so scalar selection is underdetermined.
immediate_consequences: single-state unlabeled isomorphism classes are completely classified by sort(n)
component-type equality yields a canonical token partition up to isomorphism
every intrinsic scalar factors through the orbit signature
multiple inequivalent exact scalar readouts survive all primitive symmetries
the unlabeled orbit quotient does not carry a single-valued induced composition without relative component alignment
conditional additivity plus S3 invariance gives c*TOTAL; unit normalization then gives TOTAL
obvious_falsifiers: two contents with equal sorted multiplicity triples are not related by an admissible S3 relabeling plus fiberwise token bijections
a retained scalar changes under token renaming or S3 relabeling
the blind packet contains an additional primitive observation or valuation law selecting one scalar
TOTAL and MAXBLOCK become equal on all admissible contents
